intros N Φ s hs
let f := fun x => Φ ↑x
have hf : LSeriesSummable f s :=
  LSeriesSummable.abscissaOfAbsConv_le f s
  let abscissa := LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f
  have h_abscissa_le : abscissa ≤ ↑s.re :=
    LSeriesSummable.abscissaOfAbsConv_le f s
  have h_abscissa_lt : abscissa < ↑s.re :=
    begin
      rw lt_iff_le_not_le at h_abscissa_le,
      intro h_le,
      contradiction
    end
  exact LSeriesSummable_lt_re_of_abscissaOfAbsConv_lt_re h_abscissa_lt
